correctness.rationale: Direct basis reconstruction yields cocycle ideal (2x), Nijenhuis torsion generated by 2c^2,2bc,2b(a-d), selfadjoint equation y(a-d)-bx+cz, and second cocycle equation 2(ax+cy)=0. Thus for char!=2 nondegenerate B=[[0,u],[u,v]] and N=[[lambda,mu],[0,lambda]] with u,lambda !=0; in char2 every nondegenerate symmetric B and invertible B-selfadjoint N qualifies. Kernel-line counting gives q^2(q-1) of each kind in characteristic2; total counts q^2(q-1)^2 odd char and q^4(q-1)^2 even char. Independent exact enumeration over F2,F3,F5 returns 16,36,400. Zeta rational functions follow from replacing q by q^m in the finite-field counts.
